description: Generate original sci-fi names — alien characters, human colonists, planets, and starships, one or ten at a time.

faqs.a: No — all names are assembled from original syllable banks, so nothing is copied from existing franchises.
faqs.q: Are these from Star Wars or Star Trek?

faqs.a: Planets combine an original root (like Zephia or Corvos) with a Roman numeral or sector number, e.g. Zephia IV or Corvos-9.
Click any generated name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a result?

howto: Pick a style: alien, human, planet, or starship.
Choose how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.
title: Sci-Fi Name Generator
